V Lens help and troubleshooting

Find installation and output instructions, and things to check when video or audio does not work as expected.

The app interface is currently in Japanese. English descriptions below include the Japanese labels to help you find each control.

  • Install and update
  • Output and OBS
  • PSD, lip sync and audio
  • Face, body and finger tracking
  • Save and transfer settings

Install and update

In the NSIS edition from 0.1.70 onward, choose Help (ヘルプ) → Check for updates (アップデートを確認…) to check manually. V Lens verifies the installer signature, then saves settings and stops output before installation. If you use 0.1.69 or earlier, install this update manually first.

From 0.1.73, the app downloads eligible updates of at least 8 MiB in up to eight parallel parts. If segmented downloading is unavailable or fails, it returns to a normal download. Both paths verify the completed file’s signature. Downloading 0.1.73 from 0.1.72 or earlier still uses the older method.

V Lens runs on Windows 11 (x64). Before updating, close the app with File (ファイル) → Exit (終了). Run the installer and approve the administrator prompt to register the virtual camera, then launch V Lens from the Start menu.

Output and OBS

To try the app, open File (ファイル) → Built-in samples (内蔵サンプル) → Simple setup, three mouth shapes (簡単セットアップ（3段階）). At the bottom of the right panel, set Output destination (出力先) to Virtual camera (仮想カメラ), then click Start output (出力を開始) directly below it.

While outputting a PSD or VRM, you can switch models, built-in samples and configured PSDs. The current connection, output format and audio settings remain in use; if preparation fails, the previous avatar continues. First-time PSD setup and switching requirements

Since version 0.1.40, the virtual camera is named “V Lens Camera.” If OBS or your calling app still uses the old “VCam” device, start output in V Lens and select the camera again. Some Windows lists display it as “V Lens Camera (Windows 仮想カメラ).”

Start output is unavailable

Open a supported file first. For a PSD, assign the mouth layers. If you selected Custom resolution and changed the width or height, click Apply (適用). If the virtual camera is not registered, register it with the installer and restart V Lens.

V Lens Camera is missing from the OBS device list

Set V Lens to Virtual camera (仮想カメラ), confirm the status is Output active (出力中), then reopen the device list for OBS’s Video Capture Device source. If V Lens reports “パイプ使用中” (pipe in use), stop output in any other V Lens instance, including an older version.

I want a transparent background in OBS

Install a compatible Spout2 plugin in OBS and set V Lens’s destination to Spout2 with transparency (Spout2（透過）). When using the virtual camera, you can instead choose a green or blue background and remove it with OBS’s Chroma Key filter.

Output continues after I close the window

The × button hides the window. To stop output, right-click the V Lens icon in the taskbar notification area and choose Stop output (出力を停止). Choose Exit (終了) to quit the app.

Add a virtual camera or transparent output to OBS

PSD, lip sync and audio

Opening a PSD displays its original layer visibility. Mouth and eye variants are initially unassigned. For three-shape lip sync, assign layers to Closed mouth (閉じ口) and Open mouth (開き口). You can also assign Half open (半開き).

The mouth does not move when I speak

While output is active, check the Raw audio (原音) meter in Audio and lip sync (音声・リップシンク). If it does not move, check the input type and device. If it moves, check the filter’s speech detection and Mouth opening level (口を開く音量). Lower the threshold if a quiet voice does not open the mouth. If camera tracking is enabled, also check the audio/camera lip-sync blend.

A PSD blend mode or effect is unsupported

V Lens supports PSD v1 with 8-bit RGB color. Make a copy of the PSD, rasterize the layers with unsupported effects or blending, then open the copy.

Assigned eye or mouth layers do not appear

Check that the parent folder is visible under Body and visibility (本体・表示状態). Hiding a folder also hides its assigned child layers. To use automatic blinking, assign Eyes open (目開き) and Eyes closed (目閉じ), then enable automatic blinking.

Set up PSD lip sync and blinking

Face, body and finger tracking

In 0.1.81, the right-hand Output tab (出力) for PSD and VRM avatars has a switch below the expression selector to turn camera tracking on or off directly. It applies and saves the change immediately while stopped or during output. Click Camera tracking settings… (カメラトラッキング設定…) for detailed settings. Settings (設定) → Camera tracking… (カメラトラッキング…) remains available.

Changes in the settings dialog apply immediately, without an Apply and save button (適用して保存). Applied settings are saved when you close the dialog and when the app exits. If a change fails, the controls return to the actual settings and show an error. If saving fails, the dialog stays open so you can retry.

Load a model, stop output, then open Settings (設定) → Camera tracking (カメラトラッキング…). Select your webcam and enable tracking. Click Start preview (プレビュー開始) to check detection. In full-body mode, Mosaic video + landmarks (モザイク映像＋ランドマーク) also shows the body skeleton and joints of both hands.

During output, you can immediately change the tracking toggle, lip-sync input source, yaw/pitch/roll limits, VRM body mode and full-body preset in the dialog. Stop output to change the camera, movement mapping or CPU/GPU selection.

In 0.1.81, full-body quality and load are grouped into Preset (プリセット) and Processing device (処理先). Light (lower load; ライト（軽さ優先）) uses lightweight body and hand models; Balanced (recommended; バランス（おすすめ）), the default, uses Body Lite and Hand Full; Heavy (prioritize body accuracy; ヘヴィ（身体の精度優先）) uses Body Heavy and Hand Full. Balanced and Heavy use the same two-inference hand confirmation. With GPU selected, Heavy still runs the body on the CPU while the hands can use the GPU. Choose a preset and processing device

My face is not detected, or the forward direction is wrong

Keep your whole face in the camera frame and check the preview landmarks. Once your face is detected, face forward in a relaxed position and click Use current orientation as reference (現在の向きを基準にする). Version 0.1.81 checks facial geometry and motion to reduce unstable estimates when a hand or another object covers the face. Normal continuous motion has no added confirmation wait.

Hands move suddenly or appear when they should not

In full-body mode, choose the Balanced (バランス（おすすめ）) or Heavy (ヘヴィ（身体の精度優先）) preset to confirm new or reacquired hands and sudden changes across two compatible inferences, adding about 33 ms at 30 FPS inference. Keep the whole hand in view, with enough light and a distance that makes the fingers visible. Presets can also be changed during output. Version 0.1.81 uses body wrists and tracking history to check temporary side-label flips and slightly displaced duplicate detections of the same hand.

A hidden elbow or hand moves differently from my real arm

It estimates hidden elbows and favors a relaxed A-pose when an arm’s position is uncertain, but its position or rotation may differ from yours. Try to keep the hand, elbow and shoulder visible. To avoid full-body tracking, choose Natural face and upper-body follow (顔＋上半身の自然な連動).

Track a VRM avatar’s face, body and fingers with a webcam

Save and transfer settings

Everyday settings are saved and restored automatically. To move them to another PC, choose Settings (設定) → App settings backup (アプリ設定のバックアップ) → Save backup (バックアップを保存…). On the other PC, choose Restore from backup (バックアップから復元…). To save only a PSD character’s settings, use Save PSD settings (PSD設定を保存…).

Settings files refer to the locations of external assets. Copy the PSDs, models, images and videos along with the JSON file.
